facts: A dashed line drawn to split a figure is a construction line only — it has no area of its own.
A length that is not marked can often be found from the marked lengths, because opposite sides of the overall rectangle must match.
Keep the units consistent, and give the answer in square units ($\text{m}^{2}$, $\text{cm}^{2}$).
steps: Split the composite shape into simple shapes.
Calculate the area of each simple shape.

foundation.solution_text:
The semicircle sits on the $6$ m top, so its diameter is $6$ m and its radius is $3$ m.
$A_1 = 6\times 4$
$= 24\text{ m}^{2}$
$A_2 = \frac{1}{2}\pi(3)^{2}$
$= 14.1371\ldots\text{ m}^{2}$
$A = A_1 + A_2$
$= 38.14\text{ m}^{2}$

The triangle has base $6$ m and perpendicular height $4$ m.
$A_1 = 12\times 8$
$= 96\text{ m}^{2}$
$A_2 = \frac{1}{2}\times 6\times 4$
$= 12\text{ m}^{2}$
$A = A_1 - A_2$
$= 84\text{ m}^{2}$

development.solution_text:
Split the plan into a base rectangle and the two side towers.
The base rectangle is $10$ m by $2$ m.
Each tower is $3$ m wide and $6-2=4$ m tall.
$A_1 = 10\times 2$
$= 20\text{ m}^{2}$
$A_2 = 3\times 4$
$= 12\text{ m}^{2}$
$A_3 = 3\times 4$
$= 12\text{ m}^{2}$
$A = A_1 + A_2 + A_3$
$= 44\text{ m}^{2}$

The pool sits $2$ m in from each side, so it is $14-2-2=10$ m by $10-2-2=6$ m.
$A_1 = 14\times 10$
$= 140\text{ m}^{2}$
$A_2 = 10\times 6$
$= 60\text{ m}^{2}$
$A = A_1 - A_2$
$= 80\text{ m}^{2}$

The triangle has base $5$ m (the shared edge) and perpendicular height $3$ m.
$A_1 = 8\times 5$
$= 40\text{ m}^{2}$
$A_2 = \frac{1}{2}\times 5\times 3$
$= 7.5\text{ m}^{2}$
$A = A_1 + A_2$
$= 47.5\text{ m}^{2}$

The semicircle has diameter $6$ m, so its radius is $3$ m.
$A_1 = 10\times 6$
$= 60\text{ m}^{2}$
$A_2 = \frac{1}{2}\pi(3)^{2}$
$= 14.1371\ldots\text{ m}^{2}$
$A = A_1 - A_2$
$= 45.86\text{ m}^{2}$

Each triangle has base $6$ m (the shared edge) and perpendicular height $3$ m.
$A_1 = 10\times 6$
$= 60\text{ m}^{2}$
$A_2 = \frac{1}{2}\times 6\times 3$
$= 9\text{ m}^{2}$
$A = A_1 + 2\times A_2$
$= 78\text{ m}^{2}$

mastery.solution_text:
$A_1 = 12\times 6$

$96\div 7 = 13.7\ldots$
Bags cannot be split, so $14$ bags are needed.

The path adds $1.5$ m on every side, so the outer rectangle is $15+1.5+1.5=18$ m by $9+1.5+1.5=12$ m.
$A_1 = 18\times 12$
$= 216\text{ m}^{2}$
$A_2 = 15\times 9$
$= 135\text{ m}^{2}$
$A = A_1 - A_2$
$= 81\text{ m}^{2}$
$81\times 40 = 3240$
